Coastal Weather Bulletin

DAILY TWO Bulletin Valid for 12 hrs from 21 UTC of 2026-08-30 to 09 UTC of 2026-08-31

 
Synoptic Situation MORNING'S WELL-MARKED LOW PRESSURE AREA OVER NORTHWEST BAY OF BENGAL & ADJOINING WEST BENGAL-NORTH ODISHA LAY OVER GANGETIC WEST BENGAL AND ADJOINING AREAS OF NORTH COASTAL ODISHA & NORTHWEST BAY OF BENGAL AT 1730 IST OF TODAY 30TH AUGUST, 2026. THE ASSOCIATED CYCLONIC CIRCULATION EXTENDS UPTO 7.6 KM ABOVE MEAN SEA LEVEL. IT IS LIKELY TO MOVE WEST-NORTHWESTWARDS ACROSS NORTH ODISHA- GANGETIC WEST BENGAL DURING NEXT 24 HOURS. SOUTHWEST MONSOON MODERATE TO STRONG OVER NORTHWEST BAY OF BENGAL AND NORTH ANDAMAN SEA; MODERATE OVER SOUTH ANDAMAN SEA.

 
Andaman area
Wind MAINLY SOUTHWESTERLY 20 TO 25 KNOTS GUSTING TO 30 KNOTS OVER NORTH ANDAMAN SEA AND MAINLY SOUTHWESTERLY 15 TO 20 KNOTS GUSTING TO 25 KNOTS OVER SOUTH ANDAMAN SEA.
Weather RAIN OR THUNDERSHOWER VERY LIKELY TO OCCUR AT MANY PLACES OVER ANDAMAN & NICOBAR COASTS.
Visibility MODERATE BECOMING POOR IN HEAVY RAIN/THUNDERSHOWER OVER NORTH ANDAMAN SEA AND GOOD BECOMING MODERATE IN RAIN/THUNDERSHOWER OVER SOUTH ANDAMAN SEA.
Sea Condition MODERATE TO ROUGH OCASSIONALLY BECOMING VERY ROUGH OVER NORTH ANDAMAN SEA AND SLIGHT TO MODERATE OCASSIONALLY BECOMING ROUGH OVER SOUTH ANDAMAN SEA.
Port Signal LOCAL CAUTIONARY SIGNAL NO. 3 IS KEPT HOISTED AT SRI VIJAYAPURAM PORT.
Storm Surge/Tidal Warning SWELL WAVES IN THE RANGE OF 19.0 - 20.0 SEC PERIOD WITH 1.4 - 1.8 M HEIGHT ARE FORECASTED DURING 17:30 HOURS ON 30-08-2026 TO 23:30 HOURS ON 01-09-2026. IT ADVISED THAT THERE IS A POSSIBILITY OF SURGING OF WAVES, BOATS TO PLY WITH UTMOST VIGILANCE, RECREATION WITH DUE CARE.

West Bengal coast
Wind CYCLONIC 20 TO 25 KNOTS GUSTING TO 30 KNOTS.
Weather RAIN OR THUNDERSHOWER VERY LIKELY TO OCCUR AT MOST PLACES WITH HEAVY TO VERY HEAVY RAINFALL AT ONE OR TWO PLACES OVER WEST BENGAL COAST.
Visibility MODERATE BECOMING POOR IN HEAVY RAIN/THUNDERSHOWER.
Sea Condition MODERATE TO ROUGH OCASSIONALLY BECOMING VERY ROUGH.
Port Signal LOCAL CAUTIONARY SIGNAL NO.-3 IS KEPT HOISTED AT KOLKATA & HALDIA PORTS WITH SECTIONAL SIGNAL NO- I AT SAGAR ISLAND PORT.
Storm Surge/Tidal Warning NIL
